حِمْلٌ : see حَمْلٌ, in five places. ―
-b2- حُمُولٌ, (S, M, K,) as pl. of حِمْلٌ, (M, K,) and of ↓ حَمْلٌ also, (K,) signifies likewise [Vehicles of the kind called] هَوَادِج [pl. of هَوْدَجٌ], (M, K,) whether having in them women or not: (M, TA:) or (assumed tropical:) camels upon which are هوادج, (AZ, S, M,
O, K,) whether there be in them women or not: (AZ, S, O:) it is not applied to camels unless they have upon them هوادج. (M, TA.) ―
-b3- See also مَحْمِلٌ, and حَمُولَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
